_comment: sim-robust-station-heartbeat-simclock-v1 bounded GPU proof config for the integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1). Purpose: prove the LAST pace-unsafe parked-station timer -- the parked-heartbeat WALL gap in restock_host/incorporation_ack.py IncorporationAckState.snapshot (and its station.py twin) -- is now SIM-clock primary, so the live_pose transfer's render-paced manip gap NEVER e-stops the mission via a station stop. coldliverecovery got collect->couple->outbound(coupled)->transfer(start+9 captures) then e-stopped BARE-named at STATION_ESTOP_PUBLISH site=tick reason='parked heartbeat lost: wall gap 30.75 s' while the SIM gap was healthy. This is the same wall-backstop-under-render-pacing class PR 231 (sim-robust-host-timers-audit-fix-v1) converted and that the RESTOCK_HEARTBEAT_UNAVAILABLE_S=120 widen addressed -- this specific STATION wall gap was missed by that audit.
_root_cause: The fully-honest live_pose transfer enables the masked_depth ARM FEED (a 2nd full-res render), slowing pacing to a measured ~8.5x average (coldliverecovery host-stack.log, collect->early-transfer span; local transfer-window samples ~5x; documented worst case 16-30x). During a multi-capture live_pose manip op the mission does not heart-beat the parked station; the SIM gap stayed within the 30 s budget while WALL stretched to 30.75 s > the flat RESTOCK_STATION_WALL_GAP_S=30, so the WALL leg tripped, the station published the global /manipulation/stop, it re-latched on the Isaac wire, and the transfer e-stopped. FIX: the parked heartbeat is now SIM-primary -- RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S is the real liveness bound and RESTOCK_STATION_WALL_GAP_S is only the FLOOR feeding a derived frozen-sim WALL backstop (pace_watchdog.frozen_sim_wall_backstop = sim_gap x 50, floored), evaluated with the SIM gap through pace_watchdog.is_dead(mode='either'). The wall leg now only catches a FROZEN sim. The ESDF staleness reject (preflight.incorporated_time) was already SIM-clock.
_how_to_run: RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY=wrist_guard RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S=30 python3 scripts/run_mobile_restock.py --start-at transfer --start-staging recorded_bay_park --stop-after verify  (with the masked_depth ARM FEED / economy on -- the exact coldliverecovery pacing; mast off). The armcam transfer staging (start_at=transfer at the recorded bay park) + the arm feed reproduces the render pacing that stretched the station heartbeat, bounded to transfer+verify on the GPU. CRITICAL: RESTOCK_STATION_WALL_GAP_S is LEFT AT ITS DEFAULT (the validator's env had 30; the 120 s quick-lever widen is NOT needed and must NOT be set -- the point is that the sim-clock fix makes it unnecessary). One GPU run at a time through flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never --force; do not touch the whispr service (pid 1339, ~2.2 GB VRAM). Do not take the GPU while the validator holds it.
_pass: PASS = the live_pose transfer reaches 'verify' with status succeeded and NO station stop: host-stack.log shows NO `STATION_ESTOP_PUBLISH ... reason='parked heartbeat lost: wall gap ...'` during an advancing sim, and the mission console shows NO `MANIP_HOST_FAILED op=transfer ... host emergency stop`. A station stop is legitimate ONLY if /clock is genuinely frozen (then the reason names the derived backstop, a much larger wall value). FAIL = any 'parked heartbeat lost: wall gap' stop while the sim clock is advancing (report the reason + the wall/sim gap verbatim).
_what_to_grep: grep -nE "STATION_ESTOP_PUBLISH .* 'parked heartbeat lost: wall gap" host-stack.log   # MUST be ABSENT during an advancing sim
grep -nE 'STATION_ESTOP_PUBLISH .* sim gap' host-stack.log                               # a sim-gap stop is legitimate ONLY if the gap truly exceeded RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S sim-seconds
grep -nE 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED op=transfer' <mission-console>.log                           # MUST be ABSENT (the coldliverecovery trip)
grep -n 'TRANSFER_CAPTURE' <mission-console>.log                                         # the live_pose captures (the render-paced window)
_no_required_config_key: The fix is ALWAYS-ON in scripts/twin/restock_host/incorporation_ack.py (IncorporationAckState.snapshot) and scripts/twin/restock/station.py (StationState.snapshot). The no-pacing path is byte-identical (on the real rig sim==wall the SIM leg fires first and the wall value is inert). No mission runtime-config key is required; the env below is backward-compatible tuning.

_suggested_env.RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S: 30 (the real parked-heartbeat SIM liveness bound for the live_pose transfer manip gap -- the same value the validator used; coldliverecovery's SIM gap stayed well under it). Default 0.5 is real-rig-tight and WILL trip the sim leg on the multi-capture manip gap -- set it for a honest live_pose run. Clamped [0.5, 600].
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_STATION_WALL_GAP_S: LEAVE AT DEFAULT (do NOT set the 120 s quick-lever). It is now only the wall FLOOR feeding the derived frozen-sim backstop (= max(floor, sim_gap x 50)); with RESTOCK_STATION_SIM_GAP_S=30 the effective backstop is ~1500 s, so coldliverecovery's 30.75 s render-paced gap can never trip it. A stale widen is harmless but unnecessary.
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_STATION_WALL_BACKSTOP_floor_note: there is no separate backstop-factor env for the station timer; the derivation reuses pace_watchdog's factor 50 (> the worst observed 16-30x pacing).
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY: wrist_guard (live_pose REQUIRES it; add ',weld' to label the SIM attach)
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_HEARTBEAT_UNAVAILABLE_S: optional widen (e.g. 120) -- the native_channel StationClient no-reply WALL backstop, orthogonal to the incorporation-ack guard this lane fixes. Already addressed by fm362; left for the client-side reply gap.

_runtime_keys_note: start_at=transfer / start_staging=recorded_bay_park / stop_after=verify bound the run to transfer+verify (mission.bounded_stages; fails closed before any boot). carry_wrist1_cap/carry_wrist2_min are the wrist_guard clear-region bounds (repo ros_host_config.json defaults 0.65 / 0.0). transfer_ground_truth=true accepts the authored bay target for the GT verify destination (labelled source='ground_truth'). Merge these into the mission runtime config (owned by the integration lane; do not edit the ~/datasets configs from a worker PR).
_orthogonal_to: transfer-live-mission-fragment.json (the live_pose transfer reach itself) and host-timers-pacing-proof-fragment.json (PR 231, the motion/payload/startup timers). This lane converts the parked-STATION heartbeat timer -- the last pace-unsafe wall timer in the host path. All run cleanly together.
_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/restock/host_pacing_harness.py (simulate_station_heartbeat) + scripts/twin/tests/test_host_timers_pacing.py (StationHeartbeatUnderPacing) drive the REAL IncorporationAckState.snapshot at 1x/16x/30x: no false-stop of a healthy station (the coldliverecovery shape), a dead station caught on the SIM leg in bounded sim time, a frozen sim caught on the derived WALL backstop, 1x byte-identical. Per-state guards in test_restock_host.py / test_restock_station.py. Full audit table + the measured pacing: docs/host_timers_audit.md.
